decisions.reason: Having survived launch and fitting our demanding-environment engineering niche, this naval line likely sits near an acceptable aspiration level, so we keep it while monitoring orders.

The desk lamp remains somewhat peripheral to our systems-focused strategy, but with organisational slack and a plausible ergonomic role in office applications we keep it for now despite elevated review risk.
As a core interior-lighting platform close to our established business, it likely clears aspiration thresholds relative to both our own portfolio and comparable firms, so we keep it.
Because this flagship pendant supports our strategic move toward efficient, high-quality application lighting, we keep it and see very little case for near-term withdrawal.

The marine HMI searchlight remains a narrow, less future-aligned technology and, after pruning a related marine searchlight line, we would now drop it and redeploy resources to stronger LED-oriented offerings.
